name: geo-visibility-monitor
title: GEO / AEO Visibility Monitor
description: Monitor brand visibility, citations, competitors, and changes across AI search and web search results.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Brand to monitor. Use name, aliases, and owned domains.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Questions to ask search and AI search engines.
default: best project management software for small teams

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Market objects with countryCode, languageCode, and optional location.

engines.title: Source Actors
engines.description: Apify source Actors to run. The default uses Apify Google Search Results Scraper.

sourceActorInput.title: Source Actor options
sourceActorInput.description: Optional source Actor fields. For Google Search, use aiOverview, aiModeSearch, perplexitySearch, chatGptSearch, copilotSearch, or geminiSearch to enable AEO/GEO data.

maxQueries.title: Maximum queries
maxQueries.description: Hard limit protecting the run from accidental cost growth.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Maximum results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of search result records to use for each query.

historyKey.title: History key
historyKey.description: Key-value store record used for the previous-run comparison.

includeRawSource.title: Include raw source data
includeRawSource.description: Include the source record in each output item. This increases dataset size.
